input_spec.decoder: PIL Image.convert('L'); verified bit-identical to cv2 on DeepPCB

operating_point.note: PATCH-level operating point from Day 2: threshold 0.000416 at recall 0.97 on the binary defect task. It applies to single 64x64 patches ONLY. It is NOT the board routing rule - see board_operating_point. Reusing it as a max-over-patches board rule was the Day 5 mistake: it sits below the model's ~0.0171 characteristic output on ordinary copper, so it flagged 95 of 100 tiles on a real board (n_flagged AUROC 0.5877, near chance).

known_limits: not converged (best epoch 29/30); single seed; mousebite weakest (F1 0.610); P@R=0.97 only 0.111 vs 0.094 prevalence

board_operating_point.note: BOARD-level routing rule, calibrated on Day 7 against DeepPCB _temp.jpg templates - the only defect-free boards the dataset ships. top3_mean over the 100-patch defect-score grid, selected from nine candidate statistics on specificity at recall >= 0.99 (AUROC 0.9988). Three outcomes: pass / review / fail.
